WP7: D28c: Rewards Points Program T&C item 3: "EasyEMI and e-wallet loading transactions will not accrue reward points". The record's EMI row needs category emi AND rail emi, so an EMI purchase in another category earned. Rail-EMI exclusion on all spend.

Card data review: Rewards Points Program T&C item 15(c): "Education payments made through third-party apps like (but not limited to) CRED, Cheq, MobiKwik, and others will NOT earn Reward Points." The app list is open-ended and SMS spends never carry the platform, so the aggregator condition made the row info and every education spend earned 5 RP/Rs150 (over-statement). Restated as an exclusion on the education category and the education MCCs the record gives (D20a rows). Direct school/college payments, which the issuer says do earn, are now under-stated (H2).
Card data review: an app payment may reach the card on any rail; the exclusion is not limited to online.
Card data review: the third-party-app channel cannot be told from the context (see the conditions change).

Card data review: T&C item 15(c): "education payments made directly through college/school websites or their POS machines will earn Reward Points." Direct vs third-party app is not in the transaction context, so this base-rate rule stays info with the D14b deferral flag; the education exclusion governs (under-states direct payments).

Card data review: T&C item 18: SmartBuy brand vouchers (GyFTR/Woohoo via SmartBuy) are capped at 3,000 accelerated RP a month inside the 15,000 SmartBuy cap. No loaded rule pays an accelerated rate on vouchers (only SmartBuy hotels 10X, flights 5X, trains 3X load), so the sub-cap had no target (orphan_cap) and limited nothing in either engine. Restore it when a voucher accelerator is modelled.

Card data review: D24d. MITC v4.18 (Oct 2026) I(g): "With effect from 1st July 2025, Online Skill-Based gaming transactions will not earn Reward Points/CashPoints on all the cards." The record had no gaming row. Same token as the Diners Black Metal record (v1-only entertainment row, v2 MCC 5816).
